sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-editor-2026-10-02-r2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx:Quality Checks!A5:D5; Internal Quality Checks!A5:D5; complete Quality Checks and Deterministic Checks inventories
evidence: The runtime contract is public: instruction.md:3-5 names /instructions, /assets/seed_data.json, /app, / and no sign-in; integration.md:3 states node /app/server.js, 0.0.0.0:3000 and GET /api/health; integration.md:7-9 states shared durable records, SQLite, /app/app.db and DB_PATH. overview.md:3 and policy.md:3 expressly say there are no accounts; seed_data.json has no date-dependent fixtures, and the five-second execution limit in behaviour.md:5 is elapsed time, not a fixed calendar clock. test.sh:48,68,97-109 consumes the stated health path, entry, port and DB_PATH. However ui.md:15 says, 'An invalid draft may show a useful formatting error without losing the draft,' while tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:141-146 requires for an invalid HTML draft that 'a useful formatting error must leave its exact source intact.' This converts an optional error into a mandatory part of a binary criterion. Also ui.md:13 requires visibly distinct treatment of 'declared function names'; tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:114-119 additionally requires the function name at a call to receive distinct treatment, which is not stated for call sites. These are requirements added by the judge, not implied by runtime wiring or the public notes. No raw-evidence-index.json exists for this run; the mismatch is established from frozen source, without a runtime claim.
counterexample: A custom editor that correctly formats valid JavaScript and complete HTML, leaves an invalid HTML draft untouched without a formatting error, and highlights declared function names but uses ordinary styling at call sites satisfies ui.md:13,15 and policy.md:5. It fails the all-or-nothing cw_html_format_semantics_and_undo and cw_js_semantic_coloring criteria on the extra demands.
suggested_fix: Make the invalid-HTML error and call-site colouring checks optional in those criteria, or explicitly require both behaviors in the public ui.md before freezing a new candidate.
